name: convention-generated-directory
description: A file below a directory an applied row names as one its framework generates is a generated file, so the declaration in it nothing uses is retained by the generated-file class, while the same declaration in a file the project writes is reported. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named nuxt for the package nuxt, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name the files below the pages directory and which names .nuxt as a generated directory.
